instruction:
Maker Lab Issue Set with Room Schedule

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited zone schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 7 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 2 IfcSlab entities, at least 1 IfcRoof entity, and at least 1 IfcStair entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: WORKSHOP, STORE, LOBBY, STAIR, CLASSROOM, OFFICE, WC.
7. WORKSHOP, STORE, LOBBY, STAIR are assigned to one storey; and CLASSROOM, OFFICE, WC are assigned to a second storey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, -0.3] and max [14.0, 12.0, 8.05].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneName, Area, Storey.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 7 data rows in this order: WORKSHOP 80.0 GROUND, STORE 16.0 GROUND, LOBBY 24.0 GROUND, STAIR 16.0 GROUND, CLASSROOM 48.0 LEVEL-1, OFFICE 24.0 LEVEL-1, WC 8.0 LEVEL-1, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10.
11. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A111, PLAN, SECTION, MAKER LAB WITH ROOM SCHEDULE, WORKSHOP, CLASSROOM, OFFICE, WC.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
